The entire Trump trade is unwinding heavily.

$HYPE is seen as at least slightly Trump adjacent, if for no other reason than that he said Hyperliquid aloud. His CFTC Commissioner Selig was also clearly in their corner.

Lobbying money from the @HyperliquidPC might now look wasted, or even worse, appear antagonistic to the D's coming in to power. CFTC rulemaking that might have leaned more towards @HyperliquidX might now be more neutral overall, and pushed back in timeline. Could now even be seen as the domain of the SEC. 

D's advocating for stronger insider trading laws and investigations to Trump's crypto empire are going to at least end up looking into Hyperliquid for both.

That said, it's a much different environment than it was post FTX. The American people aren't scared of crypto, they simply don't care anymore. Data centers, gas prices, war, cost of living etc all rank much higher. Even sports betting is getting more hate from some D's. 

It's be enormously unpopular for them to embark on another anti-crypto crusade when it pleases so few and alienates a wealthy lobbying group. Plenty of incoming D's are pro or at least neutral to crypto. 

$HYPE is so far down the list of trades that ought to be scared here, but it's still marginally worse. 

Fortunately, the assistance fund will keep chugging along regardless of Elizabeth Warrens hand wringing.

Yesterday, Trump Media moved around $342M worth of BTC to http://Crypto.com.

This huge transaction caught market attention, and we saw panic selling, with $BTC dropping from $80K to $75K+.

Almost $1B in liquidations.

That's what can happen with public transactions.

> Institutions move money, and retail traders panic.
> Markets become unpredictable, and liquidations peak.

That's why the idea of confidential financial information interests me.

Privacy doesn't mean giving up verification. But verification shouldn't require exposing everything, especially when it comes to big money.

I think this is the kind of adoption we still need in crypto and @primus_labs  is working towards it.

Explore Primus here: https://s.kaito.ai/R0yYiyf
